saints.name: St. Pius X
saints.title: Pope
saints.shortBlurb: A pope of humble birth who took as his motto to restore all things in Christ…
biography: Giuseppe Sarto was born to a poor family in the Venetian village of Riese in 1835 and rose through the priesthood to become Patriarch of Venice and, in 1903, pope, taking the name Pius X. His guiding motto was 'to restore all things in Christ.'

He is best remembered for encouraging frequent and early Communion, admitting young children to the Eucharist, reforming sacred music and the breviary, beginning the codification of canon law, and firmly resisting the errors he named Modernism. Simple and pastoral to the end, he died in 1914 as the First World War broke over Europe, and was canonized in 1954, the first pope so honored in centuries.
saints.knownFor: Promoting frequent Communion and defending the faith against Modernism.

sources.text: Vatican biography, Canonization of St. Pius X (vatican.va)
